title: Shader Ripples, Docks, Particle Type, Holo Cards & Toast Stacks
description: Five live UI drops: a cursor-reactive shader ripple, a magnifying macOS-style dock, particle text scatter/reform, holographic tilt cards, and sonner-style stacked toasts.

drops.title: Cursor-Reactive Shader Ripple
drops.description: A GLSL fragment shader remaps UV coordinates around the cursor with a damped, direction-biased wave instead of a flat distortion overlay.
drops.concept: Instead of layering a separate distortion effect over a video, the surface's own texture coordinates are remapped in-shader based on a smoothed pointer-velocity vector. The ripple leans into the direction of motion and decays back to rest via momentum easing, giving a 'surface being pulled' feel rather than a rigid ripple.
drops.source: Codrops — 'Magnetic Commerce: Building the Dash Creative Website'

interaction.mouse: Move across any panel to warp its surface

drops.title: Magnifying Dock
drops.description: A macOS-style floating dock where every icon's scale is a smooth falloff of its distance to the cursor.
drops.concept: On pointermove, distance from the cursor to each icon's center is converted to a scale factor via a smoothstep falloff curve, so neighboring icons partially scale too and the row ripples as one gesture. Scaling only ever touches transform (never width/height) so it stays GPU-composited.
drops.source: Dev48V (Medium) — 'I Rebuilt the macOS Dock Magnify Effect in CSS + JS'

interaction.mouse: Move across a dock to magnify nearby icons

drops.title: Particle Text Scatter / Reform
drops.description: Text sampled into thousands of canvas particles that scatter under pointer force and spring back into formation.
drops.concept: Text is rendered once to an offscreen canvas; sampled opaque pixels become particles that remember their origin coordinate. Each frame, nearby pointer proximity applies an outward force while a spring term continuously eases every particle back toward its stored origin, so the word self-reassembles the instant the disturbance stops.
drops.source: Gthibaud — 'Text particle' (CodePen), via Speckyboy's Text Distortion Effects roundup

interaction.mouse: Move across the word to scatter nearby particles

drops.title: Holographic Tilt Cards
drops.description: Pointer-reactive cards with 3D tilt, a glare hotspot, and a rainbow foil sweep — all driven by CSS custom properties.
drops.concept: A pointermove listener writes cursor position straight into CSS custom properties inside a rAF loop, bypassing framework re-renders. Those properties drive a perspective rotateX/rotateY tilt plus two overlay layers — a radial glare (mix-blend-mode: screen) and a diagonal rainbow foil (mix-blend-mode: color-dodge) — both repositioned live as the pointer moves.

interaction.mouse: Move across a card to tilt it and sweep the foil
interaction.touch: Device-orientation fallback on the first card

drops.title: Hover-to-Expand Stacked Toasts
drops.description: Sonner-style stacked toast notifications that collapse into a peek stack and fan out on hover or focus.
drops.concept: Each toast beyond the newest is visually collapsed via a scaled transform, reduced opacity, and a negative margin offset scaled by its depth in the stack, so only the top toast reads clearly while the rest peek out behind it. Hovering or focusing the container removes every item's collapse styling simultaneously so the whole queue fans out to full size.

interaction.mouse: Hover the stack to expand it, click a toast's × to dismiss
interaction.click: Fire toasts of 4 types via the control buttons
